persona.notes: Demo supervisor for mobile QA. Use the same organization as dev seed data when possible.

auth.password_any: With backend OMNIUS_DEMO_ANY_PASSWORD_LOGIN=true (default), any password works for this email.
auth.password_hint: If demo bypass is off, use the password from registration (e.g. OmniusDemo!2026).
auth.role_note: Backend User.role is a string; web app maps operator/viewer/maintenance. For UI copy you may label Omnius as Supervisor regardless of stored role until a dedicated supervisor role exists.

organization.name: Dev Organization
organization.source: Matches DEV_ORG_ID in backend/app/api/auth.py for local dev.

login_form_fields.password: (any value if OMNIUS_DEMO_ANY_PASSWORD_LOGIN is enabled on the API)
login_form_fields.comment: POST /api/v1/auth/login expects OAuth2PasswordRequestForm: fields username and password.

mobile_demo_dataset.note: Rich in-app sample: kanban columns/tasks (approvals, triage, review, done), alarms (active/acked/resolved, severities), machines + yard trailers (reefer, dry van, flatbed, tanker, held). Login still hits the API; other endpoints read from memory with ~4.5s live tick (last_seen, yard trailer, flapping alarm text).

web_app_dev_session.backend: get_current_active_user in backend/app/api/auth.py accepts Bearer dev-token and resolves to the same dev admin as the web app (admin@omniusgrid.com, DEV_ORG_ID). Mobile stores dev-token after login; all data APIs hit the real backend in parallel with the web dashboard.
web_app_dev_session.web_reference: frontend/src/pages/auth/Login.tsx — DEV_MODE username dev + devLogin(..., dev-token)
web_app_dev_session.web_vs_mobile_data: The Vite web app used to default to in-browser mocks (USE_MOCK). It now defaults to the same FastAPI as mobile. To bring back browser-only sample data without a backend, set VITE_USE_MOCK=true (see frontend/.env.example and frontend/src/api/mockMode.ts).

database_note.operator_kanban_visibility: Kanban GET /board filters role=operator to assigned_to = current user OR NULL. Migration 007_operator_kanban_assignments.sql assigns dev-org tasks to Omnius demo user so omnius@omniusgrid.com sees the same seeded board. Apply by re-running Timescale init or executing that SQL against your dev DB.

yard_api.note: organization_id is required. Mobile passes the signed-in user's organization_id from /auth/me.
